title: BuchtUtils
description: BuchtUtils is a Minecraft mod that adds a variety of new food items to the game. Enhance your gameplay with new ingredients, recipes, and culinary creations.
body:
**BuchtUtils is a Minecraft mod that adds a variety of new food items to the game. Enhance your gameplay with new ingredients, recipes, and culinary creations.**

 

**Items:**

**Cake:** A sweet treat that restores hunger. It has a 10% chance to give the player a Speed Boost effect.

**Crumbs:** The leftover bits from cakes and other baked goods. Can be consumed for a small hunger restoration.

**Dough:** A versatile ingredient used in various recipes, including cakes. Do not eat raw dough, as it’s not meant to be consumed without cooking.

**Hot Water:** A simple item that can be used in crafting or cooking recipes.

**Cake Block:** A large, stackable block made from cakes. It can be eaten and restores significantly more hunger than a regular cake, being 9 times more effective. Additionally, it has a 90% chance to give the player a Speed Boost effect, making it not only a satisfying snack but also a powerful in-game item for boosting your mobility.

**The BuchtUtils Team**
